title: Ansel and the Songbook
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: Theo Amberdale, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
